hair.note: 25 hairstyles and 7 facial-hair pieces, sculpted to the Aj head, in library/characters/aj/hair/*.npz. Each was generated with Tripo3D from a Gemini picture by the project owner. The index says: 'made for this project; check the generator's plan terms before commercial use'. That is neither CC0 nor BlenderKit royalty-free and no licence file exists, so under the owner's rule the hair stays 'unknown' until the owner confirms the Tripo plan terms (then change licence to 'own' and usable to true).
hair.why_not: licence status of AI-generated (Tripo3D) output not confirmed by the owner
hair.note_slots: slot 'hair' for the 25 styles, slot 'facial_hair' for the 7 pieces; each mounts rigidly to mixamorig:Head

quarantine.what: Mixamo character Megan (Ch22: shirt, pants, sneakers as separate meshes, 65-bone Mixamo skeleton 'mixamorig2:')
quarantine.why: Mixamo/Adobe terms are not CC0 and not BlenderKit royalty-free, so it is not allowed under the owner's rule; and the pack handover says the body has no skin under the clothes, so it cannot be fitted.

quarantine.what: Ch03_nonPBR.fbx (Mixamo character used only to size the female chest)
quarantine.why: Mixamo terms; reference only, never part of a wardrobe.

quarantine.what: BlenderKit 'Woman Dress' (chroma 3D, royalty_free) fitted on Female_Adult by the dropped stand-in method
quarantine.why: Passed the measured check, rejected by the reviewer (five major findings); the owner dropped standalone garments.

quarantine.what: BlenderKit 'Pink and Blue Pastel Varsity Jacket' (Nica Jan Alvarez, royalty_free) on Male_Adult
quarantine.why: Fails the fit check; owner dropped the standalone route.

quarantine.what: BlenderKit 'Denim Pants' (Nica Jan Alvarez, royalty_free) on Male_Adult
quarantine.why: Passed the check and the review (minor flaws) but only on one body and by the dropped stand-in route; kept out of the registry as an outfit.
